messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: streaming-decode p99 spike detected in us-east-1 on cluster 'infer-prod-3' :fire:
jamie (oncall): routing alert — I'm seeing p95 ~ 760ms, p99 ~ 4.2s for streaming endpoints (decode path). First noticed at 16:23 UTC. Dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/p95-p99
jamie (oncall): tagging @teja @maria — can you triage? Any recent kernel/compile changes pushed to infer-prod-3?
teja (eng-runtime): ack. pulling deploy history now. I see a TRT/flash-attn related kernel flag rolled out in the last 30m on that pool: "trt8-compat-v2.1" with compiler flag "-fast-kernel-path=on"
teja (eng-runtime): quick perf numbers from canary logs: streaming tail latency increased after flag. Trying to reproduce locally with same kernel + flags.
maria (eng-sre): confirmed the p99 jump correlates with that rollout by host. Also seeing increased page reclaim rates on nodes with the new kernel variant.
sophia (prod-ops): customer-impact: 3 enterprise tenants in us-east show >20% requests with streaming stalls; support already escalated one ticket (CUST-1421).
dave (support): CUST-1421: customer reports long pauses when streaming long responses, intermittently disconnecting. They've escalated to P2. Any ETA on mitigation?
jamie (oncall): mitigation options: 1) roll back kernel flag on infer-prod-3; 2) route new streaming traffic to infer-prod-1/2; 3) apply per-tenant fallback to smaller model variant. Prefer rollback + routing. Thoughts?
teja (eng-runtime): preparing rollback candidate. Command I'd run: 
```
kubectl set env daemonset/infer-runtime KERNEL_VARIANT=trt8-compat-v2.0 --namespace=prod
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/infer-runtime -n prod
```
But will trigger brief reconnects for streaming sessions.
teja (eng-runtime): also preparing a routing rule to move 15% traffic away from us-east pool as a warm mitigation: update route table in control plane to prefer region fallback for streaming endpoints.
maria (eng-sre): recommend rolling back on subset of nodes first (canary rollback) then monitor p95/p99 for 10m. If that fixes, roll forward to full rollback. I'll stand by to watch error budgets and paging.
sophia (prod-ops): agreed. Inform affected accounts and patch support playbook. I'll queue a status update to the customers and PS.
dave (support): ping me once rollback started, I'll notify CUST-1421 and offer temporary guidance to increase client reconnect window.
teja (eng-runtime): starting canary rollback on node-pool-a (20% of us-east capacity). Running: 
```
kubectl patch nodepool node-pool-a -p '{"spec":{"kernelVariant":"trt8-compat-v2.0"}}' --namespace=infra
```
teja (eng-runtime): canary applied. Restarting 6 infer pods. watch logs for decode tail warnings.
maria (eng-sre): watching metrics: within 60s p99 for the canary-hosted requests dropped from ~4.2s to ~850ms on that subset :white_check_mark:
jamie (oncall): great. teja, if canary stays healthy for 5m, proceed to roll back remaining pools and enact routing relax.
teja (eng-runtime): rolling back remaining pools now. Rolling update in 3..2..1.
deploy-bot: rollout started for daemonset/infer-runtime in namespace prod (uid: abc123).
maria (eng-sre): p95/p99 recovering cluster-wide. Current p99 = 920ms, p95 = 300ms. No increase in page reclaim.
sophia (prod-ops): support status: CUST-1421 notified. Support will keep client updated. Marking incident as 'mitigated' for customers but keeping thread open for postmortem.
dave (support): thanks. Customer asks if this was due to a kernel flag change — want to be transparent.
jamie (oncall): yes — rollout of compiler/kernel flag for TRT/flash-attn caused regression on decode path. We'll draft a summary and postmortem with timeline and root cause analysis.
teja (eng-runtime): notes for RCA: reproducer uses long streaming sequences + kv-cache eviction patterns. Kernel variant disables some eviction-friendly codegen which increases page churn for large KV set. Need more targeted flag matrix testing and perf tests for streaming tailcases.
maria (eng-sre): next steps: 1) open incident ticket INC-6181234567; 2) block-tracking for kernel flags to require streaming perf gate; 3) backfill telemetry to capture page reclaim by kernel variant.
sophia (prod-ops): I'll own the customer comms and status post.
jamie (oncall): closing the immediate page — marking 'operational' but we'll continue with RCA. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: NOTE: Incident INC-6181234567 created, priority P2, assigned to eng-runtime and eng-sre for RCA.
